text: The fresh re-read of A17 matched the earlier working record on every field it covered — circular shape, vivid red fill, identifier "A17" printed in black sans-serif below, on the same white 384x384 field — so there is no contradiction, no swap, and no drift to report; the re-inspection simply confirmed rather than expanded the prior description. What changed is coverage, not content: the record now holds nine completed reads, with G73 (horizontal ellipse, teal), H84 (crescent, magenta) and I95 (two vertical bars, brick red) added as new pixel observations, whereas the earlier record stopped at F62. Two caveats remain: the G image's pixels were not delivered in its result, so G73 still leans on that result plus my own reading rather than visible confirmation, and the added items introduce no measurements, so the earlier limits on sizes, color values, contrast, and the numbering scheme stand unchanged; shape plus transcribed identifier remain the color-independent cues.
